mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing muscle storage after a meal with liver glucose release between meals was most worthwhile: the two results made the different messages and their purposes clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing each message into blood felt a little repetitive because both pictures already showed the pairing.

surprise.text: It was useful to see that insulin stays outside the muscle cells rather than becoming part of the stored carbohydrate.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the pairings, though they made the choices quite direct.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how other body systems connect, although I would hope for some less predictable choices.
